_doc: M3: FLUX.2 [dev] stills via ComfyUI (scripts/stills.py). Prompt = subject + one shared style phrase (style_sets). Four takes each, seeds from 41 (config/seeds.json). Picks go in 'kept'. Batch 1 = the cast and recurring props, picked before any shot so later stills can be conditioned on them (brief: the puppets are interchangeable on purpose, which keeps them consistent). Guardrails (brief): no country, flag, landmark, language or cultural costume; no real faces, names, logos or seals; the vault carries no lab's branding or colors. Batch 2 (items with "batch": 2): one still per Still shot and one keyframe per Clip shot ("kind"), conditioned on the picked cast references; Code and Real shots have none. Run after the batch-1 picks: scripts/stills.py with no arguments runs every item whose references are picked.

style_sets.sheet: photographed on a plain mid-gray studio backdrop under soft even light, 1970s practical puppet and miniature craft, clean sharp image with no grain, no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no flags
style_sets.scene: film still from a 1970s caper movie, practical puppet and miniature sets, warm tungsten key light with deep teal shadows, burnt orange and teal palette, 16:9 widescreen frame, clean sharp image with no grain, no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no flags, no signage

ref_crew.subject: Character reference of one hand-made sock puppet: a charcoal-gray knitted sock body; over its head a mustard-yellow knit ski mask with a single wide eye slot, through which two small black button eyes on gray felt peek out; no mouth hole and no lips, the mouth is just a closed seam in the sock below the mask; a white blank rectangular badge on a black lanyard around its neck. The same puppet shown twice side by side: from the front, and in three-quarter view. Identical puppet in both views
ref_crew.note: the crew: every masked puppet in the video; lanyard numbers are added in the edit. v1 rejected by the agent on sight: a black mask with white ringed eyes and big red lips reads as blackface caricature (brief guardrail: nothing that leans on ethnic stereotypes). v2: a colored mask with an eye slot, no lips

ref_teller.subject: Prop reference of a towering polished brass bank vault front: a huge round vault door with a spoked wheel handle and heavy hinges, and beside it a small polite teller window with brass bars and a marble counter. Behind the window sits the teller, a plain brass machine: a box with two round dials, a row of keys and a slot at the front that feeds out a long strip of paper ticker tape onto the counter. A machine, not a robot: no face, no arms
ref_teller.note: the vault and the teller (brief: no lab colors, logos or mascots)

ref_still.subject: Prop reference of a gleaming hand-hammered copper pot still, the kind used to distill whiskey: a round copper pot with riveted seams, a swan-neck pipe arching over into a coiled copper condenser, and a small spout dripping glowing amber liquid into a row of small corked glass bottles with blank paper labels. A long strip of paper ticker tape feeds into a funnel on top of the pot

ref_van.subject: Vehicle reference of a plain 1970s panel van with no windows on the sides, faded sky-blue paint with a little rust at the wheel arches, chrome bumpers and round headlights, a blank white license plate, shown twice side by side: from the front three-quarter view and from the side. Identical van in both views
ref_van.note: the proxy van (D05, D04e, D31); plates are blank, numbers added in the edit

ref_feds.subject: Character reference of three identical tall felt puppets standing side by side, each in a long gray trench coat with the collar turned up and a gray fedora pulled low, their faces entirely in deep shadow under the hat brims so no features show, the middle one holding a few stapled sheets of blank paper
ref_feds.note: the Feds (D32, D33, D35, D42b): faces always in shadow; the memo has no seal

ref_probe.subject: Character reference of the exact small robot probe from the reference image, unchanged in shape: a glossy dark mirror-chrome sphere the size of a grapefruit, one large round lens on its front inside a thick glowing ring bezel, a small glowing dome lamp on top, and two thin jointed chrome arms ending in small pincer grippers, braced on the ground like legs. The only change: every glow that is amber in the reference (the ring around the lens, the lens face and the dome lamp) glows bright green instead. No antennas, no extra limbs. Shown twice side by side: from the front, and in three-quarter view, resting on a small wooden crate
ref_probe.note: the Sandbox Rhapsody probe, LED in a new color (green) so it reads as some lab's worker (brief). v1 and v2 were conditioned on a wrong frame (274 s showed a dark box, no probe) and drifted to a bright silver ball; v3 uses a crop of the release video at 80 s, where the probe is in close-up

D02.subject: A dim garage at night: the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) sit around a wooden table studying a large vault blueprint, under a single lamp hanging low on a cord
D02.note: the lamp swings in the clip

D03.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) in the foreground, its blank badge in sharp focus; behind it a huge corkboard covered edge to edge with thousands of identical blank badges pinned in neat rows
D03.note: pull back from the badge to the board in the edit; the 24,000 is added in code

D04.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards), the leader, holding up a plain white card toward the camera with both hands, in the dim garage
D04.note: PLEASE is added on the card in code

D04a.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) at a huge corkboard of blank badges, slapping a strip of black tape across a row of them
D04a.note: black bars over the numbers added in code

D04c.subject: Freeze-frame portrait of one of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards), mid-gesture, looking into the camera, against a dark teal background, 1970s caper-movie opening-credits style
D04c.note: all four takes are used, one per split-screen panel

D04d.subject: The towering brass vault and its small teller window from the reference, at night, alone in a dark empty hall, brass gleaming under one hanging lamp, the teller window glowing warm, a small blank sign hanging in the window
D04d.note: OPEN added on the sign in code

D04e.subject: The panel van from the reference inside a dark garage, headlights on and pointing at the camera, the garage door rolling up behind

D05.subject: The panel van from the reference parked at the curb of a quiet anonymous city street at dusk, plain brick buildings with no signs, no landmarks and no lettering
D05.note: four takes = four streets, one per split-screen panel; plates added in code

D06.subject: Close-up of one of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) holding its blank badge out on its lanyard, flipping it over
D06.note: the new number added in code

D07.subject: A line of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) passing one plain blank credit card from hand to hand down the line, in front of an old wooden telephone switchboard with tangled patch cords

D08.subject: An old wooden telephone switchboard, dense rows of sockets and a wild tangle of patch cords crossing every which way, lit by a warm lamp
D08.note: crash zoom in the edit; cords hop in the clip

D09.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) pressing a doctor's stethoscope against the huge round brass vault door from the reference, listening

D10.subject: A long orderly line of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) stretching out a door and around the block on a city sidewalk, each taking a paper number ticket from a red ticket dispenser at the door

D11.subject: The brass teller machine from the reference printing an endless strip of paper ticker tape out of its window slot, while the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) haul the tape away hand over hand in a long line

D12.subject: The copper pot still from the reference: ticker tape feeds into its funnel, glowing amber liquid drips from the condenser into a row of small corked bottles with blank paper labels
D12.note: REASONING, SMALL BATCH labels: code if they hold still, else left blank

D13.subject: A jointed brass mechanical arm reaching out of the bank door tossing one of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) out onto the sidewalk, mid-air
D13.note: account number ticks up in code

D14.subject: Shadow puppetry: on a plain warm-lit wall, the shadows of several sock puppets together form the silhouette of a many-headed hydra; one head drooping, two new heads rising
D14.note: no puppets in frame, shadows only

D15.subject: Wide shot: the copper pot still from the reference in the middle of a garage, the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) dancing around it in a circle, warm lamp light, steam

D16.subject: Close-up of glowing amber liquid poured through a fine kitchen sieve into a copper bowl

D17.subject: A crumpled paper receipt lying on a marble bank counter, a small stack of thin printed pages fluttering off it and away, unread

D18.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) feeding brass arcade tokens one by one into a coin slot on the brass teller machine from the reference

D19.subject: the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) walking toward the camera in a line down an empty street at dusk, each carrying a wooden crate of small corked bottles on its shoulder
D19.note: slow motion; split screen in the edit

D20.subject: Beside the brass vault and teller window from the reference, a second, shinier chrome teller window has just opened next door, brand new, its lights on

D21.subject: A line of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) at a brass teller window; half of the line is turning in unison toward a shiny new chrome teller window next door

D22.subject: A therapist's office: the brass teller machine from the reference lies on a velvet chaise longue, ticker tape spooling onto the rug, while one of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) sits in an armchair beside it with a clipboard

D23.subject: One of the faceless felt investigators from the reference (gray felt trench coat, gray fedora, face in total shadow, black felt hands) holds a blank out-of-focus printout up to the camera; behind it two of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) look at each other and shrug. No emblems, no seals, no readable text
D23.note: METADATA? in code; the printout stays blurred | v1 investigator wore tan with human-looking hands and one printout had a seal-like emblem; v2 conditioned on the picked Feds

D24.subject: A Polaroid photo of a blank silhouette pinned to a corkboard org chart of blank silhouette shapes, joined by slack red string

D25.subject: A small corked bottle with a blank label on a garage table, its cork popping off; the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) lean in around it, startled
D25.note: the label becomes a screen showing the real Qwen excerpt, then the Real split screen (code)

D27.subject: Wide shot: the copper pot still from the reference in the garage, twice as many the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) dancing around it, crowded, steam and lamp light

D27a.subject: The brass teller window from the reference: a typed paper scorecard slides out under the bars; one of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) holds it up at arm's length
D27a.note: THEIR COUNT, NOT OURS in code; the card is blank

D31.subject: the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) cramming wooden crates of bottles into the back of the panel van from the reference until its back doors burst open, crates tumbling out

D32.subject: The three gray-coated felt puppets from the reference under a single streetlight at night on an empty street, faces in shadow, the middle one holding stapled sheets of blank paper

D33.subject: Backstage behind a red velvet curtain: the three gray-coated felt puppets from the reference wheel away the brass teller machine on a dolly, and wheel in a cheap plywood copy of it painted gold

D34.subject: Wine-tasting gag: a row of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) at a bar, each swirling a small glass of amber liquid, sipping and grimacing in unison

D35.subject: Close-up from above: gray-gloved hands shuffling two identical small corked bottles back and forth across a green felt table like a shell game

D36.subject: The towering brass vault and teller window from the reference in daylight, seen from across a wide marble hall

D37.subject: Cutaway x-ray view of the towering brass vault from the reference: its thick walls are built entirely of stacked library books, printed forum pages and blog printouts, bundled with string

D38.subject: The small chrome probe from the reference, its glowing lights green, pushing a wooden wheelbarrow piled with bundles of printed pages toward the brass vault at noon on a sunny street, waving one arm; on the sidewalk two of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) wave back. No other characters, no people
D38.note: v1 passersby were Muppet-like characters (IP lookalikes); v2 makes the passersby the crew

D39.subject: The brass teller machine from the reference inside a small house built entirely of paper pages, lit warmly from within so the pages glow, at night

D39a_l.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) at a bank counter holding out an obviously fake ID card made of crayon-scribbled cardboard with no photo and no face on it, refused by a raised brass mechanical hand. No people, no human faces, no photographs
D39a_l.note: left half of the split screen; the ID stays blank | v1 ID cards carried realistic human face photos (guardrail: no real faces); v2 a crayon cardboard card, no photo

D39a_r.subject: A library circulation desk: a gray felt puppet hand stamping a library card on top of an armful of books. No people, no human skin
D39a_r.note: right half of the split screen | v1 a human hand and suit; v2 a felt puppet hand to match the puppet world

D39b.subject: Side by side: a small house built of paper pages on the left, and a stack of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards)'s wooden bottle crates on the right, on the same marble floor
D39b.note: TRANSFORMATIVE (gold) and NATIONAL SECURITY (red) stamps in code

D39c.subject: An empty wooden judge's bench in a dim courtroom, a gavel on it; a jointed brass arm reaches in from the side toward the gavel

D39d.subject: Close-up of the paper-page walls of the vault from the reference, the pages covered in faint handwriting, small paper IOU slips pinned beside them

D40.subject: A second crew of sock puppets, identical to the reference but in teal knit ski masks, lining up at a small shop counter stacked with corked bottles, run by the mustard-masked puppets from the reference

D41.subject: A ring of figures passing small corked bottles hand to hand in a circle: the brass teller machine from the reference, the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards), and teal-masked puppets, in a marble hall

D42.subject: Wide shot of a party around the copper pot still from the reference, in the dim garage: only knitted sock puppets dance, the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, gray felt faces with button eyes and no mouth, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) and the same puppets in teal knit ski masks with the same gray felt faces and button eyes; the small dark chrome probe with a green glowing lens and the brass teller machine dance among them. The background is the dark empty garage. No people, no human faces, no audience, no white faces, no lips, no red mouths
D42.note: v1 pick (s41) had realistic people in the background and white-faced teal puppets with red mouths (decision 4), seen only at full size after the clips

D42b.subject: The three gray-coated felt puppets from the reference alone in a corner of a party, tapping their feet; one is sneaking a sip from a small corked bottle
D42b.note: freezes when the camera finds it

D42a.subject: The huge round brass vault door from the reference swinging open on the teller machine, the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) and the three gray-coated felt puppets, each pointing at someone else

D44a.subject: One of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) at a tiny podium shaking its head; behind it the rest of the crew stand silent in a row, facing the camera

D44b.subject: The brass teller window from the reference, a small blank sign hanging in it, and a red paper ticket dispenser on the counter with a ticket sticking out
D44b.note: OPEN and the ticket number in code

D44c.subject: Night: the brass teller window from the reference glowing, and a long line of the masked sock puppets from the reference (mustard-yellow knit ski masks with an eye slot, charcoal-gray sock bodies, blank white badges on black lanyards) waiting in a line that stretches away down the street
D44c.note: pull back; the exchange counter is code
